name: fdm-design
description: Installs the fdm-design skill: CAD-agnostic design rules for FDM/FFF printed parts and electronics enclosures (orientation, overhangs and bridges, walls, fits, heat-set inserts, load paths, connector openings from plug envelopes, cable corridors, shell joints), hard rules against six recurring failure modes, and four Python checks (geometric overhang audit, forced-support slice check, mesh check, interference check), each tested against fixtures that must fail.
